_comment: FAST heat profile (10 Sep post-mortem): MARKET legs, fired concurrently and atomically, never rest. No cancel flood (nothing to cancel), so the serialised client keeps polling ~880/s instead of collapsing to 314. Signal is the raw crossed book (own_resting stays empty with MARKET legs). Rare residuals hedged at MARKET immediately (small, because atomic pairs fill together). min_edge_cross margin skips the 1-tick leftovers the field leaves; take the fat crosses.
